$description: Nirva voice rules as patterns. Used by tests/copy.test.ts, scripts/lint-ui.mjs (the Claude Code PostToolUse hook) and the CLAUDE.md experiment. Case-insensitive, word-bounded.

rules.why: Nirva is a personal insight product, not a recorder or note-taker.
Feelings aren't gauges. Show evidence counts or bands, never numbers.
Patterns are tendencies with counts, not laws.
Not a clinician. Describe what she sounded like, not what she has.
About her state, never a verdict on her or on anyone else.
